theme.title: Miller time
theme.subtitle: Reggie Miller's Pacers
theme.recap: Reggie Miller tormented the Knicks, made threes in 68 straight games and once scored eight points in under nine seconds.

questions.prompt: What was Reggie Miller's career high in points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he scored a career-high 57 points against the Charlotte Hornets in a 134–122 win

funFacts.text: Pacers fans booed the draft selection that brought Miller to Indiana; they had wanted hometown favorite Steve Alford.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: fans watching the 1987 NBA draft booed Pacers President Donnie Walsh for the selection

funFacts.text: Miller became the Pacers' primary scoring option after Indiana traded Chuck Person in the offseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After Chuck Person was traded from the Pacers during the 1992 offseason

funFacts.text: Years later, Jermaine O'Neal stopped scoring late in a big night rather than surpass his veteran teammate's franchise mark.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: left the game with 1:43 remaining to preserve Miller's 57-point record

questions.prompt: Against the Knicks in 1995, Reggie Miller scored how many points in 8.9 seconds?
questions.context: 1995 East semifinals · Game 1 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored eight unanswered points in 8.9 seconds in Game 1

funFacts.text: The comeback featured a stolen inbounds pass from Anthony Mason between Miller's dramatic jumpers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: stole the inbound pass from Anthony Mason

funFacts.text: John Starks missed both free throws on New York's next possession, leaving the door open for Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Starks missed both free throws

funFacts.text: Patrick Ewing grabbed the offensive rebound but his putback bounced off the back rim.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: his shot was just a bit long and hit the back rim

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 1994 East finals at Madison Square Garden, how many fourth-quarter points did Reggie Miller score?
questions.context: 1994 East finals · Game 5 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 39 points (25 in the fourth quarter alone) in the Pacers' 93–86 victory

funFacts.text: Director Spike Lee was seated courtside at Madison Square Garden, and Miller talked animatedly at him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: engaged in an animated discussion of his ongoing performance with noted Knicks fan Spike Lee

funFacts.text: That explosive road performance put the Pacers ahead in the series, but the Knicks ultimately eliminated Indiana.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: but they lost the next two games and the series

funFacts.text: The player later earned the nickname 'Knick Killer' for his repeated postseason torment of New York.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: most notably against the New York Knicks, for which he earned the nickname "Knick Killer"

questions.prompt: The 1999–2000 Pacers set a franchise record for consecutive home wins. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including a franchise-best 25 game win streak at home

funFacts.text: The Pacers finally defeated the rival Knicks in the Eastern finals to reach their first NBA championship series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Pacers advanced to the NBA Finals for the first time in franchise history

funFacts.text: Indiana's coach during that Finals run was former Boston Celtics star Larry Bird.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Indiana Pacers  Larry Bird

funFacts.text: Both finalists were playing in newly opened home arenas, Indiana's Fieldhouse and Los Angeles's Staples Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: both teams in the Finals featured newly built arenas

questions.prompt: From November 1996 to April 1997, Reggie Miller made a three in how many straight games?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miller made a three-pointer in 68 consecutive games from November 15, 1996, to April 6, 1997.

funFacts.text: Miller remained with Indiana for his entire playing career, an increasingly rare feat for a long-tenured star.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: played his entire 18-year career in the National Basketball Association (NBA) with the Indiana Pacers

funFacts.text: He eventually joined the exclusive fifty-forty-ninety shooting club, combining accuracy at the line and from the field.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He is one of only nine players to join the 50–40–90 club

funFacts.text: Miller's career three-pointer record eventually passed first to Ray Allen, then to Stephen Curry.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His record was later broken by Ray Allen, who was later surpassed by Stephen Curry
